section31Items.textVerbatim: immutable sealed assurance versus mutable external availability

quotedSubstance.sealedCapability: IMMUTABLE. Frozen at request validation, committed in the admitted PlanIntent, and carried in the sealed SemanticCapabilityClosureV3. No availability event can change it.
quotedSubstance.effectiveCapability: DERIVED AT READ TIME from the sealed capability plus the current availability state. Never persisted into the sealed Run and never an input to any sealed identity.
quotedSubstance.terminalLoss: APPEND-ONLY. Recorded by appending to UnitAvailabilityLedgerV1. A terminal state is never reversed and no entry is ever edited or removed.
quotedSubstance.authority: WITHDRAWN BELOW VERIFIABLE. authoritative is derived as rank(effectiveCapability) >= rank(verifiable). Withdrawal is a read-time derivation returning false, not a rewrite of RunAuthorityIndexV1.
quotedSubstance.structuralBasis: v22's UNIT-ID-V3 preimage excludes objectStates and effectiveCapability, and SemanticCapabilityClosureV3 forbids objectStates, unitAvailabilityRecords and effectiveCapability outright. The mutable side therefore cannot enter the sealed bytes even by accident.

expiryHalf.whatIsMissing: There is no retention PERIOD or TTL concept anywhere in the reviewed retention corpus. ProjectRetentionPolicyV1 is closed with exactly six ordered fields (schemaVersion, projectId, posture, consentRecordRef, policyRevision, retentionPolicyId) and a binary postureEnum ['DURABLE_RETAINED','EPHEMERAL_ONLY']. Nothing in it can express a duration, so nothing can trigger an expiry event.
expiryHalf.mitigation: The typed degradation BEHAVIOUR is reusable: a time-triggered retention sweep is an 'authorized retention action inside the tool's protection domain', which is exactly the PURGED terminal state's stated meaning. So the lattice would not need new states. What is missing is the trigger and the policy field that expresses it.
expiryHalf.cdRt5Conditionality: This is the one place where the CONTENT of the CD-RT-5 answer changes the remaining work. If the answer selects DURABLE_RETAINED or EPHEMERAL_ONLY, the reviewed schema suffices and nothing further is owed here. If the answer is time-bounded or tier-graded, ProjectRetentionPolicyV1 must gain a field, which is a retention-tiers successor plus a full independent review cycle.

orderedPathToSignature.question: If the product owner answers CD-RT-5 tomorrow morning, what is the ordered remaining path to signature?
orderedPathToSignature.headlineAnswer: Answering CD-RT-5 settles exactly ONE of the eight section 3.1 items - item 3 - and unblocks part of item 7. It does not shorten the critical path, because the critical path does not run through CD-RT-5. It runs through (a) authoring the section 7.1 parked identity recipes, which is item 2 and is what actually holds EVIDENCE at UNSET, and (b) authoring a Phase-1A packet and taking it through a real independent review cycle. Both can and should be started before the answer arrives.
orderedPathToSignature.theMostUsefulSingleSentence: Three of the eight items are already reviewed and merely unapplied, one is the product answer, and four require authoring - so the honest bottleneck is authoring plus at least one full independent review cycle on a packet that does not yet exist, and this corpus has never passed a new artifact on its first review.
whatTheAnswerActuallyBuys: Item 3 is settled by the answer alone.
Item 7's OPERABILITY G19 limb loses one of its two blockers (its blocker field names 'TM.V10 / ARCH.RETENTION-TIERS').
TM's 'reconcile V10/custody' condition loses the custody half of V10 requiredResolution item 2.
Nothing else. Items 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 8 are unmoved by it.
whatIsNotBlockedOnItAndShouldStartNow: The TM physical ProjectId-namespace re-review (step 1) - dispatchable tonight.
The section 7.1 parked identity recipes (step 2) - the long pole.
The EVALUATION-PROOF successor with a sound checker (step 3).
orderedPathToSignature.doNotCompressThis: A Phase-1A packet must be AUTHORED and INDEPENDENTLY REVIEWED, and that is a real cycle. Stated plainly because an underestimate here is worse than a long number: the packet does not exist today, its largest input (the section 7.1 byte recipes) does not exist today, and the corpus's own record shows 2 to 7 review rounds per surface with a median of 3 and no first-attempt passes. This is not a next-day signature under any reading of the evidence.

orderedSteps.step: Already done - do not re-do it
orderedSteps.detail: Items 4, 6 and the purge half of item 5 have converged, independently reviewed artifacts with zero blocking findings (retention-tiers.v24, PASS both parts; evidence.v10, PASS 0 blocking). Item 1's MODEL exists and is reviewed (evaluation-proof.v8). Item 2's verification/regeneration CLOSURE exists and is reviewed (retention-tiers.v22). Item 3's 'is retention implicit' half has a reviewed structural answer (ProjectRetentionPolicyV1 has no default field by construction). Freeze section 4.6 already grades V10 item 3 as DISCHARGED. None of this needs redoing and none of it is waiting on the product owner.

orderedSteps.span: 1 cycle, and it does not consume the critical path
orderedSteps.detail: Start this TONIGHT - it is the only blocking-disposition item that does not wait on CD-RT-5 or on the packet. Freeze threat-model.v3.json at its current digest per section 7.2.1, record the digest in the dispatch, and scope the dispatch to the SPECIFICATION (lexical contract + recovery/quarantine protocol), explicitly excluding the five PI-* runtime observations. See tmProjectIdNamespaceDispatchability.

orderedSteps.step: Start the section 7.1 parked identity recipes - the real long pole
orderedSteps.span: authoring, then 2-7 cycles by the calibration above
orderedSteps.detail: Also start TONIGHT. Nine recipes must become reproducible byte recipes in a binding artifact: RunId derivation, sealed Run semantic manifest identity, EvidenceDigest, Finding fingerprint, FactViewId, cache/regeneration keys, subjectScopeCommitment computation/verification, policyOutcome.derivationDigest, capabilityManifestId. The freeze says these 'must be closed by a binding artifact before signature' and that none may be closed by the freeze, the blueprint, a checker, or an implementer. THIS IS NOT BLOCKED ON CD-RT-5 AND IT IS PROBABLY THE LONGEST ITEM ON THE BOARD - it is what actually holds EVIDENCE at UNSET, and it is item 2 of the eight.

orderedSteps.span: authoring, then 2-5 cycles (one attempt already REJECTED)
orderedSteps.detail: Also not blocked on CD-RT-5. Needs a successor that carries the six-shape proofObligationsByClaimShape coverage AND gates above the defective check-evaluation-proof-v8.py, because section 7.2 forbids repairing that checker in place. evaluation-proof.v9 already tried and was REJECTED at 2 blockers. Until this lands, EVALUATION-PROOF is not seal-ready and no seal disposition may cite v8 as if its checker were sound.

orderedSteps.step: Author the D9 successor for the retention reason code
orderedSteps.detail: RT23-B-RES-01: add one deficiency member and one reason code so a purged-Run inspection carries a remedy instead of an empty reasonCodes list. Explicitly 'Not addable' in the retention artifact. Small, well-specified, and independent of CD-RT-5.

orderedSteps.span: minutes for the decision; the recording is governed - see openQuestions.CDRT5_SEQUENCING
orderedSteps.detail: This settles section 3.1 item 3 and nothing else. All four of the packet's unblocksWhen preconditions (independently reviewed evaluation-proof, verification/regeneration closure, degradation model, purge semantics) now rest on independently reviewed artifacts per freeze sections 4.5 and 4.6, so the question is answerable. CONDITIONAL COST: if the answer is DURABLE_RETAINED or EPHEMERAL_ONLY, the reviewed ProjectRetentionPolicyV1 schema suffices and no further retention authoring follows. If the answer is time-bounded or tier-graded, the closed 6-field schema cannot express it and a retention-tiers successor plus a full review cycle follows - and the expiry half of item 5 becomes live work. The product owner should know that before answering.

orderedSteps.span: real authoring work; this pass will not put a number on it
orderedSteps.detail: No artifact in this corpus declares itself a Phase-1A packet - measured, not assumed. The packet must assemble all eight items: items 1, 4, 6 and the purge half of 5 by carrying reviewed material; item 3 from the CD-RT-5 answer; item 2 from step 2's output; item 7 as a written reconciliation across EVIDENCE, TM, OPERABILITY G19, VERSIONING and the claim register; and item 8's packet-level retained checker and mutation suite, which must carry duplicate-key rejection and exact-type scalar admission from birth per section 7.6.

orderedSteps.step: Independent review of the Phase-1A packet
orderedSteps.span: 2-7 cycles - THIS IS A REAL CYCLE AND IT IS THE ONE MOST LIKELY TO BE UNDERESTIMATED
orderedSteps.detail: Section 3.1 requires the packet be 'accepted, independently reviewed'. By this corpus's own record, no new artifact has ever passed its first independent review, and the packet is wider than any single surface that took 5 or 7 rounds. Budgeting one cycle here is the single most likely way this plan goes wrong.

orderedSteps.step: Amend or adjudicate the binding product packet for CD-RT-5
orderedSteps.detail: Section 3.1: 'The binding product packet must be explicitly amended or adjudicated by product authority after independent Phase-1A review.' Section 4.5: 'A product decision is constituted only by product-dispositions.v1.json or an explicit amendment by the product authority.' Section 4.4 records what happened the last time an intent was converted into a recorded decision without this step. Under the strict reading this is where CD-RT-5 is actually CONSTITUTED, and step 5 is the owner forming the answer rather than recording it.

orderedSteps.step: Insert the packet into the freeze and reconcile the five targets
orderedSteps.span: mechanical for the insertion; the reconciliation is authoring
orderedSteps.detail: Apply items 1-6 into the freeze; move retention-tiers.v24, evidence.v10, evaluation-proof and the successors from CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED to applied; take OPERABILITY G19 from BLOCKED-NO-MECHANISM to IMPLEMENTABLE (the bar for signature is IMPLEMENTABLE, not DEMONSTRATED); resolve threat-model finding V10 from UNRESOLVED; reconcile VERSIONING; then reconcile the claim register against every section 3 row.

orderedSteps.step: Re-review EVIDENCE and TM to lift the two UNSET dispositions
orderedSteps.span: 1-3 cycles each; TM's is narrower if step 1 already landed
orderedSteps.detail: Both currently read UNSET - BLOCKS FREEZE, and the disposition column governs over the verdict column. EVIDENCE needs its identity recipes (step 2) reconciled and the packet inserted. TM needs V10/custody and G19 reconciled - and, if step 1 landed, nothing else.

Section 9.1: check-claims.py passes; check-completeness.py reports 13/13 independently reviewed, zero cross-cutting opens and the agreed seal-ready bar with every sub-4/4 shape accounted for; every retained binding checker passes, meeting the two named exceptions with their cause. Note two known reds a signer must meet rather than discover: check-package-coherence.py exits 1 on PC-7 until a RUST-PROVIDER-PROTOCOL successor stops pinning the REJECTED v2 base, and its --selftest refuses with 'SELFTEST-REFUSED: base is dirty' at 0 of 9 mutations. Then section 9.2: run make-freeze-manifest.py and record the payload digest.

orderedSteps.span: the ceremony itself is short; the four signers are not interchangeable
orderedSteps.detail: Section 11 requires all fields complete: Disposition, Freeze version, Date, Payload hash, Snapshot/tag, Architecture signer, Product signer (scope + CD-RT-5), Implementer litmus reviewer, Named non-blocking residual IDs. The implementer litmus (section 8) is a separate human step: give a strong Rust implementer only the freeze, the blueprint and contract links, and they must answer twelve questions - two of which are 'what retained objects establish a no-match and verdict after Phase 1A' and 'what happens after proof expiry/purge without rewriting the sealed Run', i.e. exactly items 1, 2, 5 and 6. That litmus cannot be rehearsed before the packet is inserted.

A plan that budgets one review cycle for a new Phase-1A packet is budgeting for an outcome this corpus has never produced.
spanCalibration.andThePacketIsWiderThanAnyOfThem: Each row above is ONE surface. CDRT5_SEQUENCING.question: Must the binding product packet's CD-RT-5 amendment follow the independent review of the Phase-1A PACKET, or does the review of the four unblocksWhen precondition artifacts satisfy it?
CDRT5_SEQUENCING.theTension: Freeze section 3.1 closes: 'The binding product packet must be explicitly amended or adjudicated by product authority after independent Phase-1A review.' But product-dispositions.v1.json#pendingDecisions.CD-RT-5 unblocksWhen reads: 'Phase 1A supplies an independently reviewed evaluation-proof, verification/regeneration closure, degradation model, and purge semantics' -- and freeze sections 4.5 and 4.6 record that all four of those now rest on independently reviewed artifacts.
CDRT5_SEQUENCING.whyItMatters: Under the loose reading the owner can constitute CD-RT-5 tomorrow morning (step 5 records it). Under the strict reading the packet must be reviewed first and the owner's answer is not CONSTITUTED until step 8. The ordered path above shows both, which is why step 5 and step 8 are separate.
CDRT5_SEQUENCING.thisPassCouldNotResolveIt: Correct. It is a governance reading of the freeze's own words, not a measurement, and section 4.4 is a standing warning against an architecture lane resolving it by inference.
CDRT5_SEQUENCING.recommendation: Ask the coordinator to state which reading governs, in the freeze, before the answer is given. It costs nothing now and is expensive to unwind.

EVIDENCE_COST_RESIDUAL.question: What exactly is the 'cost-residual reconciliation' the EVIDENCE row requires?
EVIDENCE_COST_RESIDUAL.whatWasTried: The EVIDENCE row's phrase is 'exact proof/verification-closure/cost-residual reconciliation'. This pass located the proof and verification-closure limbs but could not find a definition of the cost-residual obligation in evidence.v10 or in the freeze.
EVIDENCE_COST_RESIDUAL.consequence: Classified INDEPENDENT-WORK above on the basis that nothing names it as Phase-1A-blocked, but its SIZE is unmeasured and it may be larger than assumed. Do not treat its absence from the critical path as established.

TM_PUBLICATION_BLOCK.question: Does 'preserve publication block until demonstrated' require a demonstration before signature, or only that the block be preserved?
TM_PUBLICATION_BLOCK.thisPassReadsIt: As a preservation obligation, dischargeable by confirming the block stands.
TM_PUBLICATION_BLOCK.why: The alternative reading would require demonstrated threat properties before signature, which contradicts freeze section 9.1's expectation of NOT-RELEASE-QUALIFIED at signature and would make the freeze unsignable.
TM_PUBLICATION_BLOCK.flagged: If the signer reads it the other way, TM cannot clear before implementation and the whole path changes shape. Worth one sentence of confirmation.

PACKET_SCOPE.question: Is the Phase-1A packet one artifact or a named set?
PACKET_SCOPE.why: Section 3.1 says 'insert all of the following from the accepted, independently reviewed Phase-1A packet' (singular) but the eight items are owned by at least five different surfaces with separate lineages, checkers and reviewers. Whether the packet is a new binding artifact that restates them, or a manifest that binds the existing reviewed candidates by digest, materially changes both the authoring span in step 6 and the review span in step 7.
PACKET_SCOPE.note: The second shape would be much cheaper and would exploit the fact that four items are already reviewed. This pass takes no position; it is an architecture decision.
